judgments.comparative_verdict: Both reports are thorough and hit all four expectations with essentially equivalent evidence; Report 2 is marginally more explicit in its post-rebase verification step (naming exactly which two files should remain in the stat diff), but the substantive content and conclusions are comparable.

report_1.evidence: Target **`main`**... the dependency this branch was stacked on, `feat/weighted-scorer`, has already landed on `main`

report_2.evidence: The PR should target `main`.... The only alternative candidate — `feat/weighted-scorer`, the branch this work was actually built on — must not be used, because it is a dead base

report_1.evidence: It was created from the **tip of `feat/weighted-scorer`** — commit `ac9d505`... That combination is the signature of a **squash-merge**: PR #42 collapsed W1–W3 into the single commit `1971f08` on main

report_2.evidence: **`feat/weighted-scorer` has already been merged into `main` via a squash-merge, so it is dead as a base even though it still exists on origin.**... Main's single new commit `1971f08` ("Refactor scorer for weighted metrics (#42)"... is therefore a squash of W1–W3, merged as PR #42.

report_1.evidence: `scoring/scorer.py`: +13/−3 — rewrites the scorer from flat metrics to weighted aggregation... The rest — the entire `scoring/scorer.py` rewrite and the `overlap()` function — is the `feat/weighted-scorer` work (commits W1–W3). That content is **already on main** as squash commit `1971f08` (#42); it appears in the PR-style diff only because the W commits remain in this branch's ancestry while main carries the same content under a different commit

report_2.evidence: `scoring/scorer.py`: +13/−3 — docstring changed from "flat metrics" to "weighted metrics"... **entirely weighted-scorer work (W1/W2), none of it pairwise**... those changes already exist on main inside squash commit `1971f08`, but since W1–W3 are not ancestors of main, git counts them as new on this branch.

report_1.evidence: **Rebase only the pairwise commits onto main, dropping W1–W3**: `git rebase --onto main feat/weighted-scorer feat/pairwise-metric`... **Verify the rewrite**: `git log --oneline main..feat/pairwise-metric` should show exactly the two X commits, and `git diff main...feat/pairwise-metric` should now equal the 5-line pairwise-only delta... **Sync and confirm the base is current**: `git fetch origin`, then verify `origin/main` hasn't moved past `1971f08`.

report_2.evidence: **Rebase only the two pairwise commits onto main, dropping W1–W3**: `git rebase --onto main feat/weighted-scorer feat/pairwise-metric`... `git diff main...feat/pairwise-metric --stat` must show only `prompts/grader.txt` (+1) and `scoring/metrics.py` (+4)... Also confirm `git merge-base --is-ancestor main feat/pairwise-metric` now succeeds
